title: SEBI Extends Accredited Investor Deadline for Angel Funds to March 31, 2027
content:
# SEBI Extends Accredited Investor Deadline for Angel Funds to March 31, 2027

Ek important update hai. Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) ne Angel Funds ke liye Accredited Investor mandate ki deadline ko extend karne ka announcement kiya hai.

Yeh extension specific Angel Funds ke liye hai, jinhone SEBI se registration September 10, 2025, ya usse pehle liya tha.

*   **Old Due Date:** Pehle, in Angel Funds ko September 8, 2026, tak Accredited Investor mandate ko comply karna tha.
*   **New Due Date:** Ab, yeh deadline badhakar **March 31, 2027**, kar di gayi hai.
*   **Key Condition:** Is transitional period ke dauraan, Angel Funds 200 se zyada non-accredited investors ko investment opportunities offer nahi kar sakte. March 31, 2027, ke baad, yeh funds naye investments ke liye non-accredited investors se contributions accept nahi kar payenge. Existing investors ke investments par iska koi asar nahi hoga.

Yeh decision Alternative Investment Fund (AIF) industry se mile representations ke baad liya gaya hai, jismein additional time ki request ki gayi thi.

Yeh update SEBI Circular No. HO/19/34/11(7)2025-AFD-POD1/I/20626/2026 dated September 7, 2026, ke through announce kiya gaya hai.
